Message Bots like teammates... on Android

Give tasks to Bots like you would a teammate on Android. Your AI companion takes projects from start to end, keeps durable context on how you work, and comes back when your approval is needed.

Parallel Companion Roster

Deploy a roster of specialist bots on your phone—one on daily companion tasks, one on world watches, one on document extraction. Agents execute in parallel with persistent state.

Direct Android System Hands

Connect your companion once. It orchestrates device intents, system apps, and background tasks seamlessly with granular privacy controls.

Proactive Background Routines

Schedule recurring morning digests, periodic API checks, and background monitors that run reliably around the clock.

Local Persistent Memory

Bots maintain persistent SQLite workspaces and vector memory on your device, getting smarter with zero telemetry.

Multi-Agent Swarm

Run specialist bots (Yuki, Eval Bot, Pixel, Sage, Scout) concurrently with seamless context hand-offs.

Specialist Swarm Roster

Generate pipeline overnight. Researches accounts, scores contacts with intent, drafts email and LinkedIn in your voice, and leaves a review list for you to approve.

Direct Bug Reports & Feedback

Encountered a bug or an intent error? Email the lead developer directly. Include these 3 items for fastest resolution:

  1. 1. Attach a screenshot or short recording of the screen
  2. 2. Copy the exact error message or unexpected behavior
  3. 3. Briefly describe the user action right before it happened

FAQs

MOBOT is an autonomous companion that runs natively on Android. Unlike cloud chatbots that only return text, MOBOT executes actions using direct Android intents (Google Maps, camera, notifications, background routines), keeps persistent memory in local SQLite, and operates completely offline with zero telemetry.

No. MOBOT is exclusively built for Android (Android 10+ ARM64). MOBOT utilizes native Android platform capabilities including system intents, local SQLite databases, foreground services, and quick setting tiles that are specific to the Android operating system. There are no iOS or desktop applications.

No root is required. MOBOT runs as a standard Android application using sandboxed Android APIs, intent dispatchers, and foreground services.

You interact directly on your Android phone through voice dictation, chat bubbles, quick setting tiles, and background world watch notifications.

MOBOT is 100% free and open-source under the MIT license. You only pay for your own LLM API tokens if you connect cloud models, or $0 forever when running local models.

Yes. Every MOBOT specialist bot on your device accesses a unified, ACID-compliant local SQLite database with vector indexing, allowing seamless task hand-offs while isolating sensitive workspace threads.

All agent conversations, workspace files, credentials, and location intents remain exclusively on your device. MOBOT has no analytics servers, no cloud telemetry, and no intermediate proxy.
